messages:
Ayesha: quick heads-up — PelicanLabs (trial) showing a ~30% token usage spike on NLU endpoints and a renewal touchpoint in 12 days. Proactive perf play i'm proposing: run an int8 quant pilot + route a portion of traffic to a compact model variant (redwood-compact-v1) during business hours, keep full model as fallback, and enable prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts. Want to avoid any latency regressions that would hit their UX. Thoughts?

Samir: SGTM. start small — 5% canary, monitor p95 and error rates. any internal perf sims? do we have regressions on hallucination/quality for compact?

Devon: we ran a quick sim yesterday on similar workload. numbers:
```
full-model (baseline): cost 1.00x, p95 180ms, rouge/bleu-ish baseline
compact-int8: cost 0.55x, p95 205ms (+25ms), small bump in tokenization variance
notes: tail impact concentrated on >1024 seqs, hallucination rate on our eval set increased ~0.6% absolute (still within tolerance for classification usecases)
```
Short takeaway — good cost win, small latency tail tradeoff. recommend routing policy that prefers compact for short requests and falls back on full-model for long-context or low-confidence outputs.

ops-bot: rollout-plan created: canary_id=rl-canary-8821; steps=5%->25%->75%->full; health_checks=[p95_latency<250ms, error_rate<0.5%, quality_regressions<=1%]; auto-rollback=true. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/projects/pelicanlabs/rollouts/rl-canary-8821

Ayesha: perfect — i'll ping PelicanLabs AM and schedule enablement/observability walkthrough for tomorrow. Samir can you add the routing policy into their config? i want business-hours routing to compact and off-hours to default model, with KV caching TTL=60s for repeat prompts. also we should prepare a short eval promptset to track quality drift.

Samir: on it. policy draft: 
``route: if seq_len <= 512 and confidence>=0.85 -> redwood-compact-v1; else -> redwood-full-v2;``
will seed canary at 5% now and push to 25% after 2h if health checks pass. linking alert runbook in the thread.

Devon: adding evaluation set now — 120 representative prompts from Prod, plus 30 edge cases. will run automatic nightly eval and post diffs to the dashboard. watch metrics: exact_match, regen_rate, avg_tokens. if quality delta > 1% we trigger rollback or partial split.

Ayesha: also flagging renewal team — i'll attach expected monthly cost reduction (~40%) to the renewal packet. schedule: enablement + 2-week canary window -> review -> propose committed Dedicated credits for Pelican if they like the perf/cost.

Samir: FYI added a short checklist for SEs: 1) confirm tokenization parity 2) run eval set 3) prepare rollback command 4) ensure KV prefixes are instrumented.

Devon: small note — for requests with user-provided system prompts we should avoid compact until we vet safety checks. will annotate policy accordingly.

Ayesha: awesome team — will capture this in the CS playbook entry and update the customer record. tagging follow-ups: @Samir check canary at +2h, @Devon post nightly eval, ops-bot keep me notified on any auto-rollback. :thumbsup:
